title: sweeps locked to curved faces along other paths

cases.name: c001
cases.description: a cylinder (radius 10, 30 tall): a 1 × 1 square across its side swept along a left-handed helix on it (2 turns, 20 high), locked to the side

cases.name: c002
cases.description: a cylinder (radius 10, 30 tall): a thread's triangle (1 out, 1.6 along) on its side swept along a right-handed helix on it, locked to the side

cases.name: c003
cases.description: a cone frustum (radius 10 to 6, 20 tall): a 1 × 1 square across its side swept along a helix round it (3 turns), locked to the side

cases.name: c004
cases.description: a cylinder (radius 10, 30 tall): its side split by a circle of radius 4 on the plane x = 15 projected normal to it; a 1 × 1 square swept round the split edge, locked to the side

cases.name: c005
cases.description: a sphere of radius 10: its face split by a plane 5 from its centre, tilted 30° from its axis; a 1 × 1 square swept round the split edge, locked to the sphere
